title: Binance Hack Wallets Move $137 Million in Ethereum After Two Weeks of Silence
description: A wallet linked to October’s record Binance theft moved $63 million in ether, before analysts flagged a larger wave of transfers and reported Bitcoin swaps amid ongoing U.S. recovery efforts.

title: Nvidia Board Shuts Down Jensen Huang Comeback, Launches Search for New CEO
description: Nvidia's board rejected a comeback for its ousted co-founder as it hired a search firm, backed interim CEO Colette Kress, and tightened oversight of chip exports to China.

title: Tokenized Nvidia market cap surges 159% amid Jensen Huang’s exit
description: Nvidia stock tokens reached $401.9 million in combined value as Jensen Huang stepped down and the chipmaker posted record quarterly revenue. ]]>

title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
description: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable. ]]>

title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
description: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market. ]]>

title: Wrapped Monero Token Collapses 99% After $13 Million Hack Blamed on Web Host
description: Wagyu’s XMR1 token fell more than 99% after an attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of its deployer account and sold a fraction of them for $13.5 million.

title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
description: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it. ]]>

title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
description: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.
